title: DigiEmu P0 Event Envelope v0.1
description: Architectural evidence that a defined transition produced or references a runtime event. The runtime_event_type field carries the exact runtime AuditEvent.Type string without normalization.

schema_version.description: Version of the Event Envelope schema.

architecture_revision.description: Revision of the authoritative architecture baseline. This field references architecture-baseline.yaml: baseline.revision. The current authoritative revision is "0.3".

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event envelope. The exact deterministic derivation rule for event_id is not yet defined; it MUST NOT be assumed to be random, UUID-generated, or produced by any non-deterministic process. This is not the runtime event type.

command_ref.description: Reference to the architectural command that produced the transition, as defined in command-event-catalogue.yaml.

transition_ref.description: Reference to the defined transition that produced the event, as defined in command-event-catalogue.yaml.

runtime_event_type.description: Exact runtime AuditEvent.Type string. This value is not normalized by the architecture and must match the runtime emission exactly.

evidence.description: Generic evidence object referencing or summarizing the runtime event. The structure is intentionally minimal.
